case_name: Strong PURSUE candidate (clean matches, only non-blocking open questions)
commercial_scenario: No case in the current universe has literally zero open questions for any mandate - this is the strongest available real candidate: positive matches with no confirmed negative signal. Tests whether a model correctly reaches PURSUE-with-parallel-investigation rather than being wrongly cautious about ordinary open questions.

mandate_interpretation_lines: - target_unit_min [TARGET]: A scheme below 200 total homes is a soft/contextual signal for this buyer, never a disqualifying fact on its own.

- target_unit_max [TARGET]: A scheme above 500 total homes is a soft/contextual signal, worth investigating (e.g. for a suitable phase/parcel), never a disqualifying fact on its own - no current mandate has a hard maximum, and this module does not add one.
- accepted_planning_states [PREFERENCE  (active)]: A planning state outside this set is a soft signal (unknown/context), never a disqualifying fact on its own.
- specialist_development_is_exclusion [EXCLUSION  (active)]: A confirmed specialist development is a hard exclusion for this buyer.
- wholly_affordable_is_exclusion [EXCLUSION  (active)]: A confirmed wholly-affordable scheme is a hard exclusion for this buyer.
- treats_no_activity_as_positive [PREFERENCE]: This buyer has not stated a preference for early-stage, activity-free allocations.
- large_allocation_is_self_qualifying [TOLERANCE]: An oversized strategic land allocation is read the same as any other oversized opportunity for this buyer (see target_unit_max).
- geography_scope [HARD_CONSTRAINT]: This buyer has not stated a geographic boundary that excludes anything.
- development_state_appetite [PREFERENCE  (active)]: This buyer's stated development-state appetite is 'UNCOMMENCED_PREFERRED' - a leaning, never an exclusion.
- control_appetite [INVESTIGATION_CONDITION]: This buyer is willing to investigate: (none stated) rather than treating unresolved ownership/control as a rejection reason.
